sizing_method: Select annual route-km/car targets; convert BoQ to daily demand; size mould/curing, winding, test, transport and crane resources after measured cycle times and yields.

station_electrical_cost_basis.charging_rate_basis: 60-second-connected-case; 45-second interface and corrected 4.67C battery require separate rating and quote
exclusions: actual winding electrical/thermal and 45-second charging rating
unpriced_topologies: A-whole-zone winding: installed current/kVA and winding losses not established

terminal_electrical_cost_basis.charging_rate_basis: 60-second-connected-case; 45-second interface and corrected 4.67C battery require separate rating and quote
exclusions: actual winding electrical/thermal and 45-second charging rating
unpriced_topologies: A-whole-zone winding: installed current/kVA and winding losses not established

terminal_service_zone_pricing: One complete two-direction electrical package per one-way service zone; no speculative shared supply or single-lane discount
unpriced: station structures, accessible exits and full MEP
actual45-second services charger upgrade and ratings,external utility reinforcement,storage/PV
special crossings and terminal curved-detail/land premiums
land/air rights and major utility works
wider_corridor_pricing_scope: Each passenger winding uses its installed length and selected research charger; every fixed top-up has a full two-direction electrical target without charger credit, plus separately counted mount/cabinet stock. Recovery kits have independent portals/footings and no sharing credit. Higher voltage/thermal supplier premiums, access and physical acceptance remain unpriced.
